lines.text: “A Winter’s Promise” meets “The Scholomance Trilogy” with a snarky, stabby, scheming heroine who could give Kaz Brekker a run for his money. Lured in by the promise of fantastical beasts, I was swept away by the intricate world building and slow burn romance. If you like a long con, be prepared for twist after twist…and an absolute gut punch of an ending! Amanda A.K.'s Staff Picks
